resources.string: Rewrite a Nightmare
Imagery rehearsal, practised while you are awake
How it works
Pick one nightmare that keeps coming back. Start with one that is not your worst.
Write a new version of it. Change anything you like: the place, the people, what happens, how it ends. It does not have to be realistic.
Keep it short and calm, a few sentences written as if it is happening now. Leave out the frightening details of the old dream.
Once a day, while awake, listen and picture the new version for a few minutes. Rehearse only the new dream, never the old one.
Your new dream
I am back on the beach, but this time the wave carries me gently onto the warm sand…
